name: vc_capture
description: A Progressive Web App (PWA) that scans business cards using your iPhone camera and extracts contact details with Google Gemini AI. Review and edit the results, then download a `.vcf` vCard file you can import directly into your Contacts app.

scripts.build: cp index.html app.js styles.css manifest.json sw.js .nojekyll www/ && cp -r icons www/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
